Common questions

Frequently asked questions

Won't my TRS pension be enough?+
For many Texas teachers, TRS replaces only part of your paycheck — and inflation, healthcare, and taxes squeeze it further. The review shows your real number so you can see the gap clearly.
Is this a sales pitch for a product?+
No. We start with a Financial Certainty Review to find the gaps and map a plan. Any strategy is built around your TRS benefits and your life — never a cookie-cutter product.
What exactly is the Financial Certainty Review?+
A one-on-one deep dive that maps your TRS estimate, savings, and spending to show where you stand today, what could derail the plan, and a clear path to tax-smart income.
What does “tax-free” retirement income mean?+
Strategies designed so the income you draw in retirement isn't eroded by taxes the way traditional withdrawals can be — used to supplement TRS and help close your gap.
I'm close to retirement — is it too late?+
Often, no. Many teachers 8–15 years out (and even closer) can still meaningfully close the gap with the right plan. The review tells you what's realistic for your timeline.
How much does the review cost?+
Your initial Financial Certainty Review is free, with no obligation.
